primary_trigger: model cost/capability surprise or two positive application/platform earnings reactions
minimum_confirmation: application breadth expands; Meitu outperforms HSTECH and reclaims HKD4.90-5.03 with volume near or above 70.83m shares
invalidation_or_false_signal: only model/platform names rise; application earnings remain good-news-sold
limitations: Judgment interval rather than calibrated statistical probability; a later drawdown may occur in the same path

primary_trigger: two to three SaaS/application companies report positive revenue/guidance/profit conversion and Meitu H1 adds gross-margin and cash-flow proof
minimum_confirmation: peer earnings hold through T+5; Meitu formal H1 passes gross margin CFO SBC model/channel cost and diluted per-share bridge
invalidation_or_false_signal: only adjusted profit repeats preliminary guidance or price breadth fades within five sessions
limitations: Dates for some US SaaS candidates remain secondary calendar estimates until each company confirms

primary_trigger: unscheduled model/product surprise plus broad application rerating plus company-specific financial or strategic catalyst
minimum_confirmation: industry breadth price confirmation and formal company profit/cash evidence arrive sequentially
invalidation_or_false_signal: single viral product model release or cooperation headline without payer margin cash-flow and per-share follow-through
limitations: Historical main-wave threshold is ex-post and not a real-time trading signal or target price

primary_trigger: continued application multiple compression platform bundling risk or Meitu H1 quality disappointment
minimum_confirmation: risk is confirmed if gross margin CFO SBC retention or diluted owner earnings weakens while relative price and volume also deteriorate
invalidation_or_false_signal: one-day sector decline without company evidence does not by itself falsify the business thesis
limitations: Can occur after an initial rally; not a stop-loss or sell instruction
